deepseek_columns.ai_commands: sshpass -p "$DUT_PASS" ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no $DUT_USER@$DUT_IP "sudo dmidecode -t 32 2>/dev/null | grep -iA1 \"Boot Status\""
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: return FULL raw `dmidecode -t 32` output filtered to the `Boot Status` value for that section (raw text, verbatim) so the user can diff against expected; judge correctness/persistence after reboot.

historical_reviews.deepseek: YES; returns decoded text but omits variable-length raw bytes, status/additional-data boundary and scenario semantics.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION / CHANGED; adds raw scenario-aware validation but lowers capability for missing inputs/reboot approval.
historical_reviews.round_02: YES; retained direct agent collection after operator target selection and command sanity review.

original_test_intent: Validate Type 32 Boot Status and any additional status data against the actual approved boot scenario, using length-aware raw parsing and verifying the resulting boot outcome after reboot.
original_method: Collect complete raw Type 32 plus boot/OS logs, verify record length, separate six Reserved bytes from status code and additional data, decode against the approved normal-boot scenario, then repeat after an approved reboot without inventing a fault stimulus.
manual_activity: A user approves the boot scenario and reboot/recovery plan. No failure or power-loss stimulus is implied by this source row; one would require a separate approved plan.
required_inputs: Approved normal or other explicitly defined boot scenario
Applicable Boot Status code and additional-data interpretation
SMBIOS version, Type 32 length and raw decoder
safety_requirements: Use read-only SMBIOS and boot-log collection; do not induce faults, power loss or boot-configuration changes from this generic row.
Verify length and preserve raw status/additional bytes separately from Reserved.
Correlate decoded status with actual boot/OS/BMC evidence; do not treat a static value as scenario-independent.
Require reboot approval/recovery; stop on malformed data or boot failure and do not auto-retry.
agent_execution_scope: Parse raw Type 32 status/additional data, correlate it with approved boot outcome/logs and compare pre/post reboot.
Report absent, duplicate, malformed, unexpected or contradictory status without assigning PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Define expected scenario/status/additional-data semantics and approve reboot/recovery.
Interpret platform-specific status evidence and issue the verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The Type 32 label is correct, but grep cannot prove variable-length byte boundaries, raw status code, additional data or scenario correlation.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Archive full raw/decoded Type 32 and boot logs; report handle/length, six Reserved bytes, raw/decoded status, additional data, actual scenario and pre/post semantic diff.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The Boot Status scope, Type 32 script and 5/5-minute values are retained; only the source-required approved reboot is considered, not an invented fault.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Parse raw Type 32 length and status/additional bytes, keep Reserved separate, correlate the code with an approved boot event and boot-health logs, and repeat after reboot.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: SMBIOS systems containing Type 32 System Boot Information.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record SMBIOS, BIOS/BMC, decoder/dmidecode and OS versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Applicable SMBIOS Type 32 Boot Status layout/code definitions and project boot-scenario expectations.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds raw variable-length parsing, additional-data preservation and actual boot-event correlation.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Detects malformed/ambiguous status and scenario mismatch that text grep cannot establish.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Expected scenario/status mapping, additional-data policy and reboot plan.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A normal reboot validates only its resulting status; failure/recovery codes require a separately scoped and approved stimulus.

project_override_considerations: A project may choose a normal boot or separately approved failure/recovery scenario, but completion applies only to that plan; it must not claim coverage of unexecuted status codes.
expected_evidence: Approved boot scenario, status/additional-data policy and platform identity
Complete pre-event raw Type 32 with handle/length, Reserved, status and additional bytes
Timestamped bootloader/kernel/OS/BMC outcome evidence correlated to decoded status
Approved reboot/health/recovery evidence and post-event raw/semantic diff
Scope statement excluding unexecuted failure codes

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Boot Status correctly belongs to Type 32; correctness is scenario-dependent rather than a static universal value.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Once the scenario and decoder are supplied, collection, parsing and correlation are automatable; missing inputs affect readiness only.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Adds raw variable-length parsing, additional data and boot-event correlation.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains no-unauthorized-fault safeguards while restoring FULLY AUTOMATABLE capability.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates approved plan/readiness and engineer verdict from agent execution status.

review_improvement: Prevents a formatted Boot Status string from passing without proving its raw code, additional bytes and consistency with the boot that actually occurred.
independent_technical_reasoning: For an approved boot plan, raw parsing, reboot orchestration and log correlation are software-executable; formal interpretation remains engineer-owned without changing capability.
